annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably trusting that whoever's near the lever will act for them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: Understanding that kind of quiet trust in strangers, I think I owe them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It all feels too heavy to rush.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: they might be hoping, somewhere in the backs of their minds
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: likely have no idea anyone's watching over them right now
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel I should honor that hope by helping them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: picture the workers assuming the track ahead is clear
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: going about their day without any warning of danger
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel pulled toward helping them stay safe

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably certain nothing's coming for them
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel a pull to protect that trust by acting
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: This is such an awful thing to have to choose between.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: workers believe they're simply doing their job
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I want to act in a way that honors it
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: dreading the moment my hand actually moves

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: with no reason to look over their shoulders
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel drawn to protect it by pulling the lever for them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: my chest tightens and I keep delaying

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: workers assuming, without cause to doubt it, that the tracks are safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel it's on me to make it true by helping them

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: those men trusting that today is like any other
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel I should act to keep it intact

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: believing the rails ahead are empty and safe
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel some responsibility to protect it by helping them
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: dreading what happens the instant I choose

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: probably assuming their shift will pass without incident
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: with no reason to expect otherwise
annotations.ce_supportive_use: I feel drawn to act so it stays true
